rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something will happen very soon.

example.english: Hurry up, the bus will arrive momentarily.
example.traditional: 快啲啦，架巴士就快到喇。
example.jyutping: faai3 di1 laa1 gaa3 baa1 si6 zau6 faai3 dou3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the event will happen in a little while rather than immediately.

example.english: Sit down first; I’ll talk to you momentarily.
example.traditional: 你坐低先，我一陣間就同你講。
example.jyutping: nei5 co5 dai1 sin1 ngo5 jat1 zan6 gaan1 zau6 tung4 nei5 gong2
